capabilities: start, pause, and reset the focus timer
earn credits for each completed 10-minute focus block
write an auto-updated Markdown progress note in the vault
track an all-time focus total alongside the current timer
disambiguation: Not a digital-garden publishing tool; the garden is only a visual reward grown with focus-earned credits.
extras: The README covers only manual installation (placing main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css in the plugins folder); there are no screenshots or usage examples.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in focus timer, and plain timers give no reward for accumulating focused time.
summary: Focus timer that awards credits for every 10 focused minutes, spendable on objects in a small digital garden.
